notes: Archive-derived (v0.2): encoded from the online witness; not yet checked against a printed Swarabitan page.
6 glyph(s) in the source could not be decoded; they are preserved as annotation marks rather than guessed into pitches.
Taal division taken from the printed bar structure: a five-matra avartan divided 3+2. This is the Rabindrik ঝম্পক, not the ten-matra Hindustani Jhaptaal.
